title: Quasi-optimality of adaptive FEM for optimal control problems involving Dirac measures governed by biharmonic equation
summary: This article establishes the quasi-optimality of adaptive nonconforming finite element methods for a class of optimal control problems involving Dirac measures governed by the biharmonic equation. The nonconforming Morley finite elements are employed for discretising both the state and adjoint variables.
